findings.summary: The serialized shell recipe omits stage_stderr_path from STORE_CONTEXT.
evidence: make-child-venv:298-305: run_stage invokes stage_stderr_path before launching the timeout
make-child-venv:385: STORE_CONTEXT exports only failure, run_stage, progress, source_state
make-child-venv:286-296: stage_stderr_path exists in the parent source but is not exported
findings.consequence: The first recipe stage is venv. Its log setup fails before the stage command, so the maker writes only bounded failure metadata and Store.ensure rollback removes the staging tree. The reported venv-log-setup refusal is therefore explained by the source boundary itself.
findings.smallest_author_seam: Add stage_stderr_path to the existing declare -f list; do not alter Store, verifier, retention policy, or trust checks.

findings.summary: The serialized shell recipe also omits retain_stage_stderr from the failure path.
evidence: make-child-venv:120-149: failure attempts retain_stage_stderr before writing the public marker
make-child-venv:151-284: retain_stage_stderr owns the bounded 0600 private handoff
make-child-venv:385: retain_stage_stderr is absent from STORE_CONTEXT
bench_store.py:718-730: Store.ensure rolls back the creation before recording build.failure_evidence
findings.consequence: If the first helper omission were repaired alone, a later ordinary command failure or timeout would still lose the staging stderr during Store rollback because failure could not perform the handoff. Exit status and public marker fields can survive while exact private stderr remains absent.
findings.smallest_author_seam: Add retain_stage_stderr to the same existing declare -f list.

findings.summary: The 44 passing controls do not exercise the production serialization boundary.
evidence: test_custody.py:41-48,69-76,105-118,146-157 extract a contiguous source range that supplies both omitted helpers
test_custody.py:88-140 uses a test-defined build callback and manually assigns failure_evidence
No existing test asserts that every function called by the serialized STORE_CONTEXT closure is exported
findings.consequence: The source controls can prove retention behavior and Store cleanup in isolation while passing through a helper set larger than the real child shell receives. They do not falsify the observed venv-log-setup failure.
findings.recommended_control: Add a static source check for the exact STORE_CONTEXT function list and its transitive shell-function callees; if a behavioral control is later authorized, it must invoke the actual serialized recipe boundary, not supply extra helpers.
